envelope.description: Add the sidecar primitive and History

body.title: Add the sidecar primitive and History
body.summary: Add src/workflow/artifact-core/sidecar.ts (appendSidecarLine and the in-memory reader and appender) and src/workflow/artifact-core/history.ts (History with entry validation and the anchor limits), and enter the sidecar file in the inventory in the same task.
acceptanceChecks: History validates text, kind and the anchor limits and keeps prefix, suffix, section and lines through a round trip
openFeedback closes entries by addresses all and by listed ids
appendSidecarLine appends one JSON line per call to the path it is given
the inventory test passes with the sidecar file entered
